subject: Merchant intake: missing PO ref + SKU split in onboarding packet
messages:
From: Evan Lee <evan.lee@pixelscale.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor intake - need PO ref to start onboarding

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We've completed the onboarding packet and attached the signed vendor onboarding form and the SOW for the Q2 integration. Before we can spin up the first month of services we need a PO reference from Redwood so our billing team can map invoices to the correct ledger.

Two things flagged during our internal review that caused a pause on our end:
- The SOW lists SKU 48-AX (integration services) as a one-time fee, but the intake form shows it split across two line items (48-AX and 48-AX-SVC) which makes our invoicing match incorrectly.
- We requested a spend cap of $75,000 for the initial quarter; the onboarding form left the spend cap field blank.

Attached: pixelscale_vendor_onboarding_form.docx (filled), sow_pixelscale_q2.pdf

Can you confirm a PO number and whether Redwood will accept split-line invoices for the integration fee, or if you'd prefer we consolidate to a single line? We're aiming to submit our first invoice the week of July 12.

Thanks,
Evan Lee
Head of Partnerships
PixelScale Inc.
E: evan.lee@pixelscale.com
T: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evan Lee <evan.lee@pixelscale.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake - need PO ref to start onboarding

Hi Evan —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and for attaching the SOW + form. Looping in Irene and Monica from Procurement so they can triage PO issuance and the spend-cap question. Quick notes from my side:
- We're fine with a provisional PO to unblock your billing as long as we capture the final line-item mapping before the first invoice.
- Please confirm which line should be the canonical integration SKU (48-AX or 48-AX-SVC) and whether the second line is a tax/processing line or actual deliverable.
- Confirm billing cadence (net-30?) and whether invoices will be consolidated monthly or submitted per-event.

To Procurement: attaching the vendor packet — can Procurement create a provisional PO (provisionally capped) pending final SKU consolidation? If there's any reason Finance needs a different spend-band, flag it here and we'll escalate.

Karthik
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: merchant_intake_checklist.pdf (internal reference)

From: Accounts Payable <accounts@pixelscale.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Lee <evan.lee@pixelscale.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake - need PO ref to start onboarding

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the quick response. Apologies for the confusion on the SOW vs. form. Clarifying: the 48-AX line is the one-time integration milestone ($60,000). 48-AX-SVC is a small post-integration support retainer ($15,000) that we mistakenly duplicated as a separate billable line in the onboarding form; the intent is to invoice them as separate line items (one-time + retainer).

We can consolidate into a single line if Redwood prefers, but our accounting prefers separate lines to track milestone vs. recurring retainer. We propose the following to move forward without blocking the July 12 invoicing cycle:
- Issue a provisional PO: PO #654321 (proposed)
- Provisional spend cap: $75,000 (covers both integration + first-month retainer)
- Invoice frequency: milestone invoice on completion of integration; monthly thereafter for retainer (net-30)

DocuSign link to updated onboarding packet + signature token: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/ABCD-1234-PS

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, Jul 6, 2026 at 10:05 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Can you confirm which line should be the canonical integration SKU (48-AX or 48-AX-SVC) and whether the second line is a tax/processing line or actual deliverable.

Please let me know if PO #654321 works or if Procurement needs a different format for the provisional PO.

Regards,
AP Team
PixelScale Inc.
accounts@pixelscale.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Evan Lee <evan.lee@pixelscale.com>, Accounts Payable <accounts@pixelscale.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake - need PO ref to start onboarding

Evan / PixelScale AP —

Thanks for the clarification. Procurement has issued a provisional PO to unblock your onboarding:
- PO number: 654321 (provisional)
- Provisional spend cap: $75,000 USD
- Accepted invoice format: separate lines for 48-AX (integration milestone) and 48-AX-SVC (support retainer). Please include the canonical SKU mapping on each invoice.
- Billing to: ap@redwood.com (please cc vendor@redwood.com on the first invoice so we can validate mapping)
- Net terms: Net-30

Attached is the PO stub (po_654321_stub.pdf). This is provisional pending receipt of the signed onboarding packet via DocuSign; once we have the signed packet we will convert the provisional PO to a formal PO in our ledger and confirm final spend allocations.

One ask: when you return the DocuSign please also confirm the billing contact and the email address that will send invoices (to set up EDI/map).

If Finance (Priyom) needs to change the spend cap after reviewing the SOW line items, we'll update you within 48 hours. Otherwise you should be clear to submit the July milestone invoice once the SOW milestone is complete.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: po_654321_stub.pdf
